name: Notion
description: All-in-one workspace for notes, tasks, wikis, and databases with a robust developer platform.

evidence.claim: Notion uses OAuth 2.0 for public connections and static installation tokens or personal access tokens for internal and personal use.
Notion provides a complete REST API for working with pages, databases, blocks, search, and version headers.
Notion offers an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) remote server to connect AI clients to Notion workspaces.

notes: Notion offers a comprehensive public REST API supporting pages, databases, blocks, and search, alongside official SDKs, OAuth 2.0 flows, internal connections, and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
